# byleo.org — Leo Soloviev, meditation and mindset coach

> Leo Soloviev, a former corporate lawyer (trained in London and New York; practised in London, New York and Moscow) who turned to meditation in 2013 and has been coaching since 2017, helps people transform their lives with the power of real meditation, rewiring their mindset with Yoga Nidra and other traditional techniques, explained through modern science and often through animation. On byleo.org you can get a free 12-minute guided Yoga Nidra (NSDR, non-sleep deep rest) audio.

## The free audio: a 12-minute guided Yoga Nidra

- What it is: Yoga Nidra, also called yogic sleep or NSDR (non-sleep deep rest). Rooted in an ancient tradition, it is now backed by a growing body of university research for rest, stress relief and focus.
- Length: about 12 minutes (12:52). English. Narrated guidance with soft rain in the background. Free, sent by email.
- How to use it: sit or lie down, close your eyes and follow the voice. No physical exercises, no experience needed.
- When it helps: like a powerful nap without the grogginess; to calm a racing mind; any time of day when energy or focus dips; to wind down for sleep.
- The six stages: 1) settle in; 2) feel your whole body; 3) follow the breath; 4) a journey around the body, naming parts one by one (right side, left side, back, front); 5) deep rest, awake yet deeply resting; 6) come back refreshed.
- Get it: https://byleo.org/ (enter an email; the audio opens instantly and the link is also emailed).

## About Leo Soloviev

- Meditation and mindset coach; coaching since 2017.
- Started out as a lawyer: Master's in International Business Law (University of London) and Master's in Corporate Law (NYU School of Law); practised corporate law in London, New York and Moscow.
- Since 2013 has studied and practised mind techniques, including meditation and Yoga Nidra: trained with teachers in the UK and the US, and spent many months in India learning from traditional teachers, including long silent retreats. Many 7–10-day silent retreats and a month-long solitude retreat in the Himalayas.
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/byleo_org/
